gloss: during a journey; on the way; travels

definitions.gloss: during a journey; on the way; travels
definitions.explanation: The time or experience during a trip or journey. Can refer to the journey itself or events that happen along the way.

examples.japanese: {道中|どうちゅう}お{気|き}をつけて。
{道中|どうちゅう}で{面白|おもしろ}い{店|みせ}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found an interesting shop along the way.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{道中|どうちゅう}だったが、{無事|ぶじ}に{目的地|もくてきち}に{着|つ}くことができた。
examples.english: It was a long journey, but we managed to arrive safely at our destination.

notes:
A compound of {道|みち} (road) and {中|ちゅう} (during, in the middle of). Historically associated with travel along the main highways of Edo-period Japan, as in {東海道中|とうかいどうちゅう} (journey along the Tokaido road).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道中|どうちゅう}お{気|き}をつけて (take care on your journey — a standard farewell)
- {道中|どうちゅう}で (during the journey, on the way)
- {珍|ちん}{道中|どうちゅう} (comic journey, misadventure trip)
- {道中|どうちゅう}{記|き} (travel journal)

The expression {道中|どうちゅう}お{気|き}をつけて is a polite way to wish someone a safe trip. The word has a slightly literary or traditional feel compared to {途中|とちゅう} (on the way), which is more neutral and everyday.
